## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Validation

List exact commands, backends, tasks/scenes, seeds, and relevant before/after metrics.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests and lint pass.
- [ ] Public behavior and documentation are updated.
- [ ] MuJoCo and Isaac Sim impact is stated.
- [ ] Physics changes include references and regenerated fidelity results.
- [ ] New assets/data/weights include source, license, version, and checksum.
- [ ] Benchmark changes follow `docs/BENCHMARK_SPEC.md` and are versioned if comparability changes.
